name: Sodium bicarbonate; solvay process; at plant - PROXY
description: Approximated sodium bicarbonate production process using the solvay process. Inputs are based on stoichiometric calculations. The solvay process is a commonly used production process. Only incoming materials are included; processing energy, transport, and process emissions are NOT included.

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Representative of production in the US.
